spans.s:
(उ) ष्ठिवु r. 1st cl. (ष्ठीवति) r. 4th cl. (ष्ठीव्यति)
To eject from the mouth, to spit, to sputter, (the radical sibilant is unchanged in this root); also ष्ठीव.

(उ) ष्ठीवु r. 1st cl. (ष्ठीवति)
To spit or eject from the mouth.

n. (-नं)
1 Spitting, ejecting saliva.
2 Saliva, spittle.
E.
ष्ठीव, and ल्युट् aff.

ind.
Having spitten.
E.
ष्ठीव to spit, क्त्वा aff.
